# Editing an embedded Excel workbook inside a .pptx

A .pptx can embed an Excel workbook (an OLE object), e.g. a currency-rate table shown
on a slide. The workbook lives inside the pptx ZIP at `ppt/embeddings/*.xlsx`. To change
a value in it you edit that embedded part **in place** and rewrite only that one ZIP entry
— everything else in the presentation must be byte-for-byte unchanged.

## Rules
- **Preserve formula cells.** Only overwrite the specific data cell(s) you were asked to
  change. A cell whose value (read with `data_only=False`) starts with `=` is a formula —
  never overwrite it; it recalculates from the cells you change.
- **Keep the workbook openpyxl-safe.** Load with `openpyxl.load_workbook(path)` (default,
  `data_only=False`) so formulas survive the round-trip. Do NOT use `data_only=True` and
  re-save — that permanently replaces formulas with cached values.
- **Rewrite only the embedded part** back into the pptx; do not re-generate the whole deck.

## Worked example
```python
import shutil, zipfile, os, re
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pptx import Presentation

SRC, OUT = "/root/input.pptx", "/root/results.pptx"
shutil.copy(SRC, OUT)                       # start from an exact copy

# 1) find the embedded workbook part
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT) as z:
    emb = [n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith("ppt/embeddings/") and n.endswith(".xlsx")][0]
    tmp = "/tmp/embedded.xlsx"
    with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
        f.write(z.read(emb))

# 2) read the target rate from the slide text (example: "USD/EUR = 0.92")
prs = Presentation(SRC)
text = "\n".join(s.text for sl in prs.slides for s in sl.shapes if s.has_text_frame)
m = re.search(r"([A-Z]{3})\s*/\s*([A-Z]{3})\s*=\s*([0-9.]+)", text)
base, quote, new_rate = m.group(1), m.group(2), float(m.group(3))

# 3) edit only the matching data cell; leave formulas alone
wb = load_workbook(tmp)                     # data_only=False -> formulas kept
ws = wb.active
for row in ws.iter_rows():
    for cell in row:
        if isinstance(cell.value, str) and cell.value.startswith("="):
            continue                        # never touch a formula cell
# ... locate the cell holding the base/quote rate by its label and set cell.value = new_rate ...
wb.save(tmp)

# 4) rewrite ONLY the embedded part back into the pptx
tmp2 = OUT + ".tmp"
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(tmp2, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = open(tmp, "rb").read() if item.filename == emb else zin.read(item.filename)
        zout.writestr(item, data)
os.replace(tmp2, OUT)
```

After writing, RE-OPEN the output (`Presentation(OUT)` and `load_workbook` on the embedded
part) to confirm it is valid and the value changed before reporting done.
